story.body: You stopped at the end of the burned row for a bushel of barley two men were disputing, and walked on home.

story.body: You gave the maltsters a sentence, and you had no price under it. Anne would not supply one for you. You promised what you can give, and you kept your lord's ear for plays. No gentleman was named, and no sum was put on the giving.
